structural_change: tc3 (Q-TT-LEAF r3 2026-10-16): routed tc1 f9c257836 CLOSED TT +117.83/FF +0.07/DRC0 and passed every native check (601 launches worst 210.1 ps, 92/93 captures, spread 48.8 ps) EXCEPT the raw reset capture: rst_n fed all 322 async-clear flops (valid line 216, ring pointer 8, a_act/b_act 48, scale_re/gre 50) through one tile-wide buffer tree, capture 356.99 ps > 190. Structural fix in RTL: rst_n lands on ONE reset-station flop at the S-face pin (async assert, release one edge later) and only that flop drives the leaf's internal reset tree (now an internal timed recovery/removal path). Cold init: assertion unchanged; scale release E+1 vs core (first scale_v is 23 edges after release in the full-shape bench); a scale_v inside the release window is a simulation fault; normal calendar 0 cycles; +1 flop area. Core leaf scale_rst_n now launches from its own dedicated kept station flop (same IS release edge). Placement/CTS = tc1 (west SRAMs x32.4, -no_obstruction_aware); tc2 east-SRAM move dropped (it did not address reset and its gate spread was 78.9 ps). New benches: warm reset with scale words in flight (pass) and negative controls MUT3 (no internal reset distribution) / MUT4 (release 4096 edges late).
